system.name: NASH
system.one_liner: Data selection that decomposes a complex utility into Shapley-informative components and aggregates them non-linearly with concave functions.

content.variant_note: a barrel-and-potion analogy set up in two small cards, then replayed in the method card with decompose and aggregate steps
content.argues: Data Shapley cannot rank data under a complex multi-role objective, but it can on simpler components; NASH decomposes the objective and aggregates the components non-linearly.
content.subject: A barrel for the objective and potion bottles for data, split into component barrels with Shapley values on each bottle.

summary: NASH is a data-selection framework: because Data Shapley fails to rank data when the utility (such as validation accuracy) mixes several roles, NASH splits the utility into simpler Shapley-informative components and re-combines them with concave functions. Figure 1 tells this with a barrel-and-potion analogy on pink rounded cards. The top cards show the objective as a barrel with three role columns and coloured goal lines, and the data as six numbered potion bottles with mixed coloured contents. The large bottom card, titled NASH Framework, shows a Shapley magnifier on the whole barrel giving 1/6 on every bottle (not Shapley-informative), a decompose bracket into three component barrels whose bottles carry 1/2 or 0, and black curves that aggregate non-linearly into a final barrel with three green checks.
summary_zh: NASH 针对 Data Shapley 在多角色效用下失效的问题，把效用分解成 Shapley 信息充分的分量再非线性聚合。图 1 用木桶与药水瓶作类比：上方两张卡片是目标桶和数据瓶，下方依次是整体 Shapley、分解与聚合。
